name: ADS-B Exchange
desc: World's largest unfiltered/independent ADS-B aircraft feed; tracks military and blocked flights others hide.

name: Flightradar24
desc: Most popular live flight tracker; ADS-B/MLAT plus playback history; widely cited in conflict reporting.

name: OpenSky Network
desc: Non-profit research ADS-B network with free REST/historical API; ideal for bulk flight-data analysis.

name: AirNav RADAR (RadarBox)
desc: Global live flight tracker (formerly RadarBox); ADS-B/MLAT/satellite coverage with alerts and API.

name: MarineTraffic
desc: Leading live AIS vessel-tracking platform; ship positions, port calls, fleet and historical track data.

name: VesselFinder
desc: Live AIS ship and container tracking with vessel database, port info and historical track playback.

name: MyShipTracking
desc: Free real-time AIS vessel tracking with map, vessel/port databases, playback and API access.

name: Global Fishing Watch
desc: Open AIS/VMS + satellite vessel-activity datasets and API; exposes dark fleets and AIS gaps at sea.

name: AISStream.io
desc: Free global AIS WebSocket stream API; live ship positions, voyages and SAR aircraft for developers.

name: AISHub
desc: Community AIS data-exchange hub; share a feed to get raw aggregated ship positions in JSON/XML/CSV.

name: N2YO Satellite Tracking
desc: Real-time tracking and pass predictions for 34,000+ objects incl. military/recon sats; live API.

name: Heavens-Above
desc: Satellite pass predictions and 3D orbit views for ISS, Starlink and special-interest spacecraft.

name: CelesTrak
desc: Canonical free source of NORAD TLE/GP orbital element sets and SATCAT; the backbone of sat tracking.

name: Space-Track.org
desc: Official US Space Force 18th SDS space-catalog; authoritative TLEs, decay and conjunction data via API.

name: Satellite Map (satellitemap.space)
desc: Real-time 3D map of Starlink, GPS and 30,000+ satellites with constellation launch/decay status.

name: Starlink Coverage Tracker (starlink.sx)
desc: Realtime Starlink constellation map showing satellite positions, ground stations and service links.

name: WebSDR
desc: Directory of public WebSDR receivers worldwide for remote HF/VHF/UHF radio monitoring in-browser.

name: KiwiSDR Public Receiver Map
desc: Live global map/list of public KiwiSDR HF receivers (former sdr.hu successor) for remote SIGINT listening.

name: RX-TX.info SDR Map
desc: Aggregated map/table of 2,400+ WebSDR, KiwiSDR and OpenWebRX receivers and transmitters worldwide.

name: SatDump
desc: Open-source satellite signal-decoding software (APT/LRPT/HRPT) to receive and geo-reference sat imagery.
